## Cross-cutting: Tailscale, Longhorn, Argo CD, Claude OAuth, build-custom

41. [Tailscale — Kubernetes operator (KB 1236)](https://tailscale.com/kb/1236/kubernetes-operator) — T1 — Verified. "the default mode for the operator is to create a tailnet device deployed as a `StatefulSet` with a single `Pod`"; "a single `Pod` may not be feasible for large installations (high resource consumption)"; ProxyGroup exposes Ingress/egress redundantly.
42. [Tailscale — Cluster ingress](https://tailscale.com/docs/features/kubernetes-operator/how-to/cluster-ingress) — T1 — Verified. "Ingress resources only support TLS, and are only exposed over HTTPS using a MagicDNS name and publicly trusted certificates from Let's Encrypt"; "You must enable HTTPS and MagicDNS on your tailnet." A `LoadBalancer` Service with `loadBalancerClass: tailscale` exposes plain HTTP (port 80) without TLS. "Expose many Service and Ingress resources to your tailnet using a smaller number of proxy Pods" (ProxyGroup / HA mode).
43. [Longhorn issue #2445 — RWO multi-attach](https://github.com/longhorn/longhorn/issues/2445) — T2 — Verified. "The volume … cannot be attached to the node worker-5 since it is already attached to the node worker-6." Occurs when a pod with an RWO volume reschedules before the old attachment releases; RollingUpdate triggers it; workaround is to fully terminate the old pod (Recreate / StatefulSet ordered termination).
44. [Argo CD — Orphaned resources](https://argo-cd.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user-guide/orphaned-resources/) — T1 — Verified. Orphan monitoring is warn-only ("will get a warning"); resources can be excluded by Group/Kind/Name (glob); default ServiceAccount, kubernetes Service, kube-root-ca.crt auto-excluded.
45. [Argo CD — Resource tracking](https://argo-cd.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user-guide/resource_tracking/) — T1 — Verified. "If the tracking annotation does not reference the resource it is applied to, the resource will neither affect the application's sync status nor be marked for pruning." Untracked (dynamically created) resources are invisible to sync/prune.
46. [Claude Code — Authentication](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/authentication) — T1 — Verified. Linux credentials in `~/.claude/.credentials.json` mode `0600` (no keychain); honors `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`; precedence `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` > `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` > `apiKeyHelper` > `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` > subscription `/login`. `claude setup-token` mints "a one-year OAuth token" for `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, "scoped to inference only", requires Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise. Note: "Starting June 15, 2026, Agent SDK and `claude -p` usage on subscription plans will draw from a new monthly Agent SDK credit."
47. [Claude Code issue #47754 — Cloudflare WAF blocks headless OAuth refresh](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/47754) — T2 — Verified. POST to the OAuth token endpoint from headless Linux returns 403 (Cloudflare), then 429 on retry; "Token expires → refresh blocked → permanent lockout"; reporter locked out 26 days. Filed Apr 14 2026.
48. [Claude Code issue #24317 — concurrent-session credential race](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/24317) — T2 — Verified. OAuth refresh tokens are single-use; N concurrent processes sharing one `~/.claude/.credentials.json` invalidate each other's tokens, forcing re-auth. Opened Feb 9 2026.
49. [Headlamp (kubernetes-sigs)](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/headlamp) — T1 — Snippet. Browser k8s UI: in-browser pod exec, scale replicas, restart/delete, RBAC-aware — covers a browser-only start/stop/exec lifecycle without custom code.
50. [Kubernetes — StatefulSet](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/statefulset/) — T1 — Snippet. `volumeClaimTemplates` gives each replica its own PVC; ordered pod management terminates the old pod before creating the replacement (RWO-safe, unlike Deployment RollingUpdate).
51. [Claude Code issue #21765 — refresh token ignored on copied/headless creds](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/21765) — T2 — Snippet. Copying `.credentials.json` to a headless machine yields a 401 rather than using the present refreshToken; closed "not planned."
